A [[human]] '''girl''' from the [[planet]] [[Chandrila]] was friends with [[Leida Mothma]]. They had  light skin, [[color|brown]] [[hair]] and brown [[eye]]s.<ref name="One Year Later" /> In [[5 BBY]], they, Leida and a group of [[Chandrilan]] children took part in a traditional Chandrilan ceremony in the dining room of the [[Chandrilan Embassy]] on [[Coruscant]].<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix">{{Andor|Daughter of Ferrix}}</ref> A year later, in [[4 BBY]], they attended the three [[Standard day|day]] [[wedding of Stekan Sculdun and Leida Mothma]] on Chandrila. On the first day, Leida led them and a group of [[peermaid]]s to see her [[Leida Mothma's wedding dress|wedding gown]].<ref name="One Year Later" /> The following day they were present for [[Perrin Fertha]]'s speech. During the first two days they wore a blue [[Clothing|dress]] with a gold [[belt]].<ref name="Sagrona Teema">{{Andor|Sagrona Teema}}</ref> On the third day, they watched Leida and Stekan Sculdun's dance during wedding reception during which they wore a gold shirt with a cyan skirt and gold belt. Later during the reception, a [[speaker droid]] began to play music and the girl joined others in dancing to the music.<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix"/>

==Behind the scenes==
The Chandrilan girl was portrayed by [[Teresa Gotto]] in the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', first appearing in the series's eleventh episode of the [[Andor Season 1|first season]], "[[Daughter of Ferrix]]," which was released on [[Disney+]]<ref name="Daughter of Ferrix" /> on [[November 16]], [[2022]].<ref name="S1 Companion">{{InsiderCite|217|Star Wars: Andor Season One Companion|''Star Wars: Andor'' Season One Companion}}</ref>
